title: THE TRIP

scenes.narration: You're going to Hunza with four friends. You booked the hotel. You paid the deposit. Twenty-four thousand rupees.
scenes.image: YOU standing proudly next to a packed white car on a city street at dawn, four friends loading bags into the boot behind him, mountains hinted far away

scenes.narration: Nobody has sent you a single rupee yet. But it's fine. It's a trip. Vibes first.
scenes.image: YOU sitting in the front passenger seat of a car, looking at his phone with a forced smile, friends laughing in the back seat, highway through the windscreen

scenes.narration: First stop, the petrol pump. Bilal checks his pockets. Then checks them again.
scenes.image: Bilal (tall, curly black hair, denim jacket) patting his empty jacket pockets with a fake shocked face at a roadside petrol pump, YOU watching from beside the car with narrowed eyes

scenes.narration: He forgot his wallet. Again. Everyone looks at you.
scenes.image: close-up of YOU looking nervous with a sweat drop, three friends behind him all staring at him expectantly, petrol pump lights at dusk

scenes.narration: Do you cover him, or call him out in front of everyone? Comment COVER or CALLOUT.
scenes.image: YOU standing at the petrol pump holding his wallet in one hand, looking straight at the viewer, Bilal grinning sheepishly behind him, dramatic sunset over mountains

vote.question: Cover Bilal or call him out?

caption:
🚗 Day 1: Bilal forgot his wallet. Again.

Comment COVER or CALLOUT — the next episode follows the winner.
